observations: Bars 0-13 are a bear leg: window opens 2116.86, high 2139.34 (bar 1), low 1368.42 (bar 13), about -36% from the high.

Bar 13 (open 1581.32, high 1599.27, low 1368.42, close 1568.55) closes 200.13 above its low, near the top of its 230.85 range: the leg ends in a climactic reversal bar rather than a trend-continuation close.
After 1368.42 the market rallies to 1845.09 (bar 22 high) and then pulls back to 1512.91 (bar 33 low), a higher low; the subsequent leg reaches 1954.36 (bar 59 high) and 1974.46 (bar 64 high).

Bars 63-86 are a 24-bar range between 1974.46 (bar 64 high) and 1821.49 (bar 71 low); bar 63 prints 1959.37, just above bar 59's 1954.36, and bar 64 immediately reverses to close 1891.41 near its low (failed breakout/upthrust).
Bar 87 opens 1916.51 inside that range and closes 2252.16 (high 2293.80, low 1905.63), a +17.5% close-to-close bull bar; bar 88 closes 2326.32 and bar 89 reaches 2771.

Bar 89 (open 2326.31, high 2771, low 2325.31, close 2515.30) closes below the midpoint 2548.16 of its 445.69 range: a long upper tail, and the 2771 high has not been exceeded in the following 30 bars.
Bars 90-119 trade between 2357.18 (bar 101 low) and 2700 (bar 118 high) with heavy overlap and never return below 2293.80 (bar 87 high): the breakout zone 1821.49-1974.46 is left behind.
Upside probes at 2680 (bar 110 high, close 2514.72) and 2700 (bar 118 high, close 2632.98, i.e. the lower third of its 2604.75-2700 range) both closed back inside the 30-bar range.

Bar 114 sells to 2358.62 and closes 2397.10; the next five closes rise: 2416.57, 2446.22, 2612.02, 2632.98, 2642.90. Those last three are the three highest closes of the whole 120-bar window (next highest is 2515.30 on bar 89).
Bar 119 (open 2632.98, high 2645.88, low 2568.16, close 2642.90) is an inside bar versus bar 118 and closes 57.10 below the 2700 high, near the top of its own range.

structures.description: Opening bear leg of the window ending in a climactic bar: 2116.86 open, high 2139.34 (bar 1), low 1368.42 (bar 13). Bar 13 is a bear bar closing 200.13 above its low in the upper part of its range, the exhaustion bar of the leg.

Mid-window trading range, 24 bars (63-86) confined between 1974.46 (bar 64 high) and 1821.49 (bar 71 low), width 152.97 (about 8%). Bar 63 marginally exceeds the prior swing high 1954.36 and bar 64 reverses to close 1891.41 near its low: a failed breakout above the prior high.

Bull spike out of the 24-bar range: bar 87 opens 1916.51 inside the range and closes 2252.16 (high 2293.80, low 1905.63); bars 88 (close 2326.32) and 89 (open 2326.31, high 2771, close 2515.30) extend it. Bar 89 closes below the midpoint of its 445.69 range (long upper tail), so the third bar is climactic.

Post-spike trading range, 30 bars (90-119): overlapping two-sided trade between 2357.18 (bar 101 low) and 2700 (bar 118 high), never returning below 2293.80 (bar 87 high). Spike highs at 2680 (bar 110) and 2700 (bar 118) were both sold back into the range; lows after bar 101 rise from 2374.01 (bar 102) to 2568.16 (bar 119) with one near-retest at 2358.62 (bar 114).

Recent bull leg off bar 114's low 2358.62: five rising closes 2416.57, 2446.22, 2612.02, 2632.98, 2642.90, the highest closes of the window. Bar 117 closes 2612.02 near its 2643.52 high; bar 119 is an inside bar versus bar 118 and closes 2642.90, 57.10 under the 2700 range top. Still a leg inside the 30-bar range, not an accepted breakout.

evidence_for: Swing progression since the 1368.42 low is higher lows (1512.91 bar 33, 1512.91 -> 2357.18/2358.62 bars 101/114) and higher highs (1845.09, 1954.36, 1974.46, 2771), which is a bull sequence at the window level.

The bar 87-89 spike closed far above the 24-bar 1821.49-1974.46 range and the following 30 bars never traded back below 2293.80 (bar 87 high), so the breakout was accepted rather than reversed: the range/base is left behind.

The window's three highest closes are the last three bars (2612.02, 2632.98, 2642.90), and bar 119 closes near the top of its range at 2642.90, showing buyers still pressing at the range top at the decision time.
Lows inside the post-spike range rise after bar 101 (2374.01, 2411.04, 2413.82, 2436.87, 2568.16), a mild upward tilt consistent with a bull flag rather than a topping structure.
evidence_against: 30 of the last 33 bars are a two-sided 2357.18-2700 range with heavy overlap; the 2771 spike high made 30 bars ago is still the window high, so trend continuation is not confirmed.

Bar 89 closed below the midpoint of its 445.69 range (buy climax), and the 2609.02-2700 area has now rejected upside probes three times (bar 113 close 2514.07 area, bar 110 high 2680 closed 2514.72, bar 118 high 2700 closed 2632.98 in the lower third of its range).
The 120-bar window contains a full 36% bear leg (2116.86 to 1368.42) in its first 14 bars, so the window is not a single clean bull trend and the bear-trend context is only 100 bars old.
No bar closes above 2700 yet: bar 118 leaves an upper tail and bar 119 is an inside bar, so the current push is still a boundary test, and repeated boundary tests in a range often resolve either way.
transition_conditions: A daily close above 2700 (bar 118 high) with a further bull close would mark acceptance of an upside breakout from the 30-bar range and support continued bull-trend/channel behaviour.
A bear close below 2568.16 (bar 119 low) followed by a break of 2357.18 (bar 101 low) would break the 30-bar range low and shift the read toward a lower high under 2771 and a range-down resolution.
Continuation of overlapping bars contained inside 2436.87 (bar 117 low) and 2700 keeps the phase 'range' and keeps always-in relevance low.
A move back below 2293.80 (bar 87 high, the top of the breakout bar's range) would undercut breakout acceptance and move the classification toward transition-unclear.
